title.narrative: Expansion of CO12 Accelerating development of new bioeconomy businesses

description.narrative: Increased government capacity to meet and track Green Growth Policy (GGP) targets on green jobs and bioeconomy strategy.

The project is an extension of CO12.The project will deliver technical assistance and capacity building during a critical electoral and government transition period to sustain green growth policy and bioeconomy strategy implementation primarily through: i) scaling up bioeconomy accelerator mechanisms, ii) capacity building for green jobs promotion and iii) Green Growth and low-carbon recommendations presented with key stakeholders for their adoption into the National Development Plan 2022-2026. All three workstreams are demand-driven and aligned with the national government’s green recovery efforts to counterbalance the post-COVID19 economic crisis.
